business_summary: Tyson Foods, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a food products company worldwide. It operates through four segments: Beef, Pork, Chicken, and Prepared Food products. The company processes live fed cattle and hog; fabricates dressed beef and pork carcasses into primal and sub-primal meat cuts, as well as case ready beef and pork, and fully cooked meats; raises and processes chicken into fresh, frozen, and value-added chicken products, including breaded chicken strips, nuggets, patties, and other ready-to-fix or fully cooked chicken parts; and supplies poultry breeding stock. It also manufactures and markets frozen and refrigerated food products, including ready-to-eat sandwich, flame-grilled hamburger, Philly steak, pepperoni, bacon, breakfast sausage, turkey, lunchmeat, hot dogs, flour and corn tortilla products, appetizers, snacks, prepared meals, ethnic foods, side dishes, meat dishes, breadstick, and processed meats under the Tyson, Jimmy Dean, Hillshire Farm, Ball Park, Wright, Aidells, Gallo Salame, ibp, and State Fair brands. The company sells its products through its sales staff to grocery retailers, grocery wholesalers, meat distributors, warehouse club stores, military commissaries, industrial food processing companies, chain restaurants or their distributors, live markets, international export companies, and domestic distributors who serve restaurants and food service operations, such as plant and school cafeterias, convenience stores, hospitals, and other vendors, as well as through independent brokers and trading companies. The company has a strategic alliance with Allied Beef Company to establish a long-term partnership to strengthen domestic cattle supply. Tyson Foods, Inc. was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in Springdale, Arkansas.
business_summary_ko: Tyson Foods, Inc.는 자회사와 함께 전 세계적으로 식품 회사로 운영되고 있습니다. 쇠고기, 돼지고기, 닭고기, 조리식품 등 4개 부문으로 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 생우와 돼지를 가공합니다. 옷을 입은 쇠고기와 돼지고기 시체를 원시 및 준원시 고기 부위로 가공할 뿐만 아니라 케이스에 준비된 쇠고기와 돼지고기, 완전히 익힌 고기도 가공합니다. 닭고기를 빵가루를 입힌 치킨 스트립, 너겟, 패티 및 기타 즉시 고칠 수 있거나 완전히 조리된 닭고기 부분을 포함하여 신선, 냉동 및 부가가치 닭고기 제품으로 키우고 가공합니다. 가금류 사육 재고를 공급합니다. 또한 Tyson, Jimmy Dean, Hillshire Farm, Ball Park, Wright, Aidells 산하의 즉석 샌드위치, 직화구이 햄버거, Philly 스테이크, 페퍼로니, 베이컨, 아침용 소시지, 칠면조, 점심 고기, 핫도그, 밀가루 및 옥수수 토르티야 제품, 전채 요리, 스낵, 준비된 식사, 민족 음식, 반찬, 고기 요리, 빵집 및 가공육을 포함한 냉동 및 냉장 식품을 제조 및 판매합니다. Gallo Salame, ibp 및 State Fair 브랜드. 회사는 판매직원을 통해 식료품 소매업체, 식료품 도매업체, 육류 유통업체, 창고형 클럽 매장에 제품을 판매합니다.
